policy.experiment: 2 inputs × 2 breadths × 2 scoring methods; no policy revisions after outcomes
inputs: frozen accepted ORB crop otherwise byte-identical raw

base.selection: NCC of mean-centered grayscale at multiple scales/translations and 0/90/180/270 reference rotations; coarse-to-fine, no labels or metadata
base.warning: Scores are heuristic, not probabilities. Template alignment may fail with glare, sleeves, severe perspective and card-background contamination.

parallelSignal.name: Robust peripheral chroma correspondence
parallelSignal.formula: newScore = unchangedBaseScore + 0.08*(2*exp(-medianPeripheralLabABDistance/25)-1); adjustment=0 on unreliable geometry or color
parallelSignal.alignment: ORB3000, ratio0.75, unique query matches, RANSAC3px,>=20inliers, ratio>=0.5, reference hull>=0.25, spans>=0.5, median<=3px,p95<=6px, convex in-bounds reference face
parallelSignal.regions: 4x6 grid on inner90% of reference, peripheral16cells only; intersect low-gradient60th-percentile pixels; reject bright low-chroma/clipped glare and L<12 shadows; >=25pixels and>=12% percell; >=6cells
parallelSignal.physicalReferenceExtent: Only unchanged34 references already independently verified in prior ORB experiment; all other images abstain. No additional per-image annotations.
parallelSignal.interpretation: One bounded generic residual signal, not a foil detector or probability. No metadata, correct IDs, candidate ranks or retrieval-label boosts.

policy.ambiguityMeaning: Top1-top2 margin below0.03 is a descriptive ambiguity flag, not a calibrated rejection threshold.
policy.crop: Reuse saved5 automatic accepted ORB crops and4 raw fallbacks unchanged; no new crop search/acceptance tuning.

baselineFreeze.purpose: Freeze all prior experiment assets before focused breadth/discriminator experiment
